question.worked_solution:
First, notice that the numbers $27$ and $8$ are both perfect cubes. 

So, to determine the value of $\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{8}},$ we express $\frac{27}{8}$ as a perfect cube:

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt[3]{\frac{27}{8}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{{3}^{3}}{{2}^{3}}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{3\cdot 3\cdot 3}{2\cdot 2\cdot 2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{\frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{3}{2}\cdot \frac{3}{2}} & = \\ \sqrt[3]{{(\frac{3}{2})}^{3}} & = \\ \frac{3}{2} & \end{aligned}
$$
